paragraphs.text: Nomad is a creature type that first appeared in Arabian Nights with Desert Nomads , which was however pluralized. Ghitu Fire-Eater was the first card to actually have the type as printed on the typeline.

Nomads are closely-knit groups of people that travel the plains or mountains from place to place to find fresh pasture for their animals and have no permanent home. Like barbarians , it is more a description of heritage than other classes. Most nomads are white or red . The last Nomads were printed in Odyssey block , with a potential return teased in Fomori Nomad .
The former classes Caravan ( Trade Caravan ) and Gypsy ( Pradesh Gypsies ) were changed into Nomad during the Grand Creature Type Update .
